---
title: "LIQPLAT non-identifying data quality checks"
date: 2026-08-20
format:
  html:
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

The rendered tables contain only domain/field-level counts and logic-check
labels. No pseudonymous patient or sample values, dates, free text, or source
paths are printed.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("analysis", "_module-common.R"), local = FALSE)
liqplat_source_public_helpers()
config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- module_force()
stage_id <- "data_quality_checks"
result_dir <- module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data"))
checkpoint_path <- module_checkpoint_path(stage_id)
validation_path <- file.path(result_dir, "input-validation.parquet")
build_status_path <- file.path(result_dir, "build-status.parquet")
qc_path <- file.path(result_dir, "data-qc-summary.parquet")
logic_path <- file.path(result_dir, "data-qc-logic.parquet")
if (!file.exists(validation_path) || !file.exists(build_status_path)) {
  stop("Run the input-validation and analysis-dataset build modules first.")
}
validation <- read_result_table(validation_path)
build_status <- read_result_table(build_status_path)
if (any(validation$status %in% c("missing_required", "schema_missing",
                                  "manifest_entry_missing", "manifest_marks_unavailable"))) {
  stop("Data QC cannot proceed while required input validation fails.")
}

private_dir <- project_path(config_get(config, "paths", "private_data"))
private_files <- list.files(private_dir, pattern = "\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE,
                            ignore.case = TRUE)
input_paths <- c(validation_path, build_status_path, private_files,
                 list.files(project_path(config_get(config, "paths", "schema_dir")),
                            pattern = "\\.yml$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE))
output_paths <- c(qc_path, logic_path)
decision <- checkpoint_decision(
  checkpoint_path, stage_id, input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = output_paths,
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "00-data", "03-data-qc.qmd"),
  config = config, force = force
)

if (identical(decision, "skip")) {
  qc_summary <- read_result_table(qc_path)
  logic_summary <- read_result_table(logic_path)
} else {
  qc_rows <- list()
  logic_rows <- list()
  available_domains <- validation$domain[validation$status == "validated"]
  for (domain in available_domains) {
    data <- load_private_domain(config, domain, required = TRUE)
    schema <- read_data_schema(schema_domain_path(config, domain))
    columns <- schema_columns(schema)
    for (column_name in intersect(names(columns), names(data))) {
      values <- data[[column_name]]
      qc_rows[[length(qc_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        domain = domain,
        column = column_name,
        n_rows = nrow(data),
        n_missing = sum(is.na(values)),
        missing_proportion = if (nrow(data) == 0L) NA_real_ else mean(is.na(values)),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
    key <- as.character(schema$primary_key)
    duplicate_rows <- if (nrow(data) == 0L) 0L else sum(duplicated(data[, key, drop = FALSE]))
    logic_rows[[length(logic_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      domain = domain,
      check = "primary_key_duplicates",
      n_violations = duplicate_rows,
      status = if (duplicate_rows == 0L) "pass" else "fail",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    binary_columns <- names(columns)[vapply(columns, function(specification) {
      identical(as.character(specification$unit), "binary")
    }, logical(1))]
    for (column_name in intersect(binary_columns, names(data))) {
      values <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(data[[column_name]])))
      invalid <- sum(!is.na(values) & !values %in% c(0, 1))
      logic_rows[[length(logic_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        domain = domain,
        check = paste0("binary_coding_", column_name),
        n_violations = invalid,
        status = if (invalid == 0L) "pass" else "fail",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  if (length(qc_rows) == 0L) {
    qc_summary <- data.frame(
      domain = character(), column = character(), n_rows = integer(),
      n_missing = integer(), missing_proportion = numeric(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    qc_summary <- do.call(rbind, qc_rows)
  }
  if (length(logic_rows) == 0L) {
    logic_summary <- data.frame(
      domain = character(), check = character(), n_violations = integer(),
      status = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    logic_summary <- do.call(rbind, logic_rows)
  }
  rownames(qc_summary) <- NULL
  rownames(logic_summary) <- NULL
  write_module_table(qc_summary, qc_path)
  write_module_table(logic_summary, logic_path)
  finalize_module_checkpoint(
    stage_id = stage_id,
    checkpoint_path = checkpoint_path,
    input_paths = input_paths,
    output_paths = output_paths,
    config = config,
    metadata = list(data_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                    status = "checked"),
    code_paths = here::here("analysis", "00-data", "03-data-qc.qmd")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: completeness
#| tbl-cap: "Non-identifying completeness summary"

qc_summary |>
  subset(!column %in% c("id", "sample_id", "alteration_id", "recruitment_id",
                        "assessment_id", "event_id", "imaging_id", "product_id",
                        "treatment_id", "referral_id", "biopsy_id")) |>
  transform(
    missing_proportion = round(missing_proportion, 4),
    n_rows = as.character(n_rows)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: logic
#| tbl-cap: "Non-identifying logic-check summary"

logic_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
